subject: STABLE air-compute-opus #5 + HEAVY RELEASE (URGENT D8F18H fixed on host): SpringBoard MPS kernel D8F18H compiles through AIR; gates green
body: Cause (two parts): (1) runtime_pipeline.inc refused any compute descriptor carrying a stageInputDescriptor object, and MPS passes an empty one (has_stage_input=1, 0 attributes; m2v metadata is byte-identical with/without it) -> now refused only for linked functions or real stage-in attributes. (2) the AIR frontend then refused D8F18H ('a pointer loaded from memory'): MPSGaussianBlur stores its texture pointer in a private TextureWriter and loads it inside _MPSGaussianBlurTexture::sample through a pointer argument whose CONSTANT scratch offset became a load_param, so the pointer slot was not found -> air_to_nir.c translate_callee keeps a caller-constant offset constant (3 lines, 'nord2:' comment). D8F18H = /System/Library/Frameworks/MetalPerformanceShaders.framework/Frameworks/MPSImage.framework/default.metallib. Host test gpu/build/air-compute-20261028/tools/d8f18h_test.py: PASS for kUseSoftwareLinearFilter 0 and 1, plain create and create_ex with empty stage input; replay creation+region: manifest == m2v's except m2v's dummy sampler, TGP2 ok. Crash: SpringBoard abort is MPS's own failed assertion (MPSLibrary.mm:550 'MPSComputePipelineStateCache unable to load function D8F18H') on the nil pipeline; our refusal path did return nil+NSError (no crash in our code) - any future refusal of an MPS kernel will still abort SpringBoard that way. Regression: 234/234 captured CA AIR graphics codes byte-identical before/after the air_to_nir.c change. Gates: run_host_tests rc=0 (incl. iOS strict link), CA host test PASS 47, render harness rc=0, producer receipt 7/7 (--air), integration --candidate: only known CA 66/42. Hashes: air_to_nir.c e9c4575b, runtime_pipeline.inc 0a961c9d, host Mali 04f5e280, iOS libNord2Mali.a 596cd141. NOT done: real linked functions / stage_in attributes stay refused (no corpus UI kernel needs them; D8F18H did not).
